verse.verse_1: When the sunlight is rolled up.
verse.verse_2: And when the stars fall down.
verse.verse_3: And when the mountains are driven.
verse.verse_4: And when milch camels roam abandoned.
verse.verse_5: And when wild animals are herded together.
verse.verse_6: And when the seas are set afire.
verse.verse_7: And when the souls are paired.
verse.verse_8: And when the girl-child who was buried alive is asked.
verse.verse_9: Upon what sin was she killed for.
verse.verse_10: And when the Records of Account are laid bare.
verse.verse_11: And when the heaven is torn away.
verse.verse_12: And when hell is further enflamed.
verse.verse_13: And when Paradise is brought near.
verse.verse_14: Every soul will then come know what it has brought.
verse.verse_15: So by oath of those that revolve. (The planets.)
verse.verse_17: And by oath of the night when it turns back.
verse.verse_18: And by oath of the morning when it takes birth.
verse.verse_19: This is indeed the recitation of an honoured Noble Messenger. (Angel Jibreel – peace and blessings be upon him.)
verse.verse_20: The mighty, the honoured in the presence of the Lord of the Throne.
verse.verse_21: The one who is obeyed, and trustworthy. (Other angels obey angel Jibreel).
verse.verse_22: And your companion is not insane.
verse.verse_23: And indeed he saw him on the clear horizon. (Prophet Mohammed saw Angel Jibreel in his true shape – peace and blessings be upon them).
verse.verse_24: And this Prophet is not miserly upon the hidden. (Allah gave the knowledge of the hidden to the Holy Prophet – peace and blessings be upon him.)
verse.verse_25: And the Qur’an is not the recitation of Satan the outcast.
verse.verse_27: That is but an advice to the entire creation!
verse.verse_28: For the one among you who wishes to become upright.
verse.verse_29: And what will you wish, except if Allah wills – the Lord of the Creation.
